Key audit matter:
Valuation of unquoted equity investments
The Group holds significant unquoted investments, comprising
investments in unlisted entities, measured at fair value through profit
and loss.
As explained under Note 17 of the financial statements, the Group
uses a variety of approaches in estimating the fair value of these
investments. The methods used in determining the fair value of the
unquoted investments involves significant estimates and assumptions
of unobservable inputs such as comparable market multiples,
appropriate discounting rates and incorporation of illiquidity and
marketability discounts.
How our audit addressed the key audit ma:
Our testing approach included amongst others, the following
procedures with the assistance of our valuation specialists;
• We assessed management’s processes and controls for
determination of the fair values of investments.
• We assessed the appropriateness of the valuation method used
and the underlying assumptions such as the selected comparable
entities, liquidity discounts, and any other adjustments.
• We tested the accuracy of the computations.
• We evaluated the adequacy and appropriateness of disclosures
in the financial statements.
